regimeSub: SPX -1.2% as AI selloff resumes; BOK hold + Warsh silence keep risk bid fragile at 5.13% 10Y.
themes: SPX falls to 7663 (-1.2% DoD) as AI/tech selloff per Bloomberg Oct 22 triggers haven bid → 10Y rallies 1bp to 5.13% but term premium remains elevated vs 3.98% YoY
BOK holds at 3.00% on Oct 22 per Korea JoongAng Daily with Nov hike signaled → USDKRW +2 to 1324 as won softens on hawkish guidance; KOSPI -3.3% WoW to 5423 on HBM peak-out fears
Fed Chair Warsh Oct 16 'price stability key' with no rate signal → Dec hike live as Sep CPI printed 4.0% YoY vs 3.7% prior; core PCE sticky at 3.0% keeps 2Y at 4.81%
Initial claims fall to 194k (3-mo low) per Bloomberg Oct 22 → labor tightness sustains wage pressure; retail MoM +0.8% confirms consumer resilience despite inflation at 4.0%
